hero.caption: Fireworks over Cinderella Castle at Magic Kingdom.
hero.author: Jorge Royan
hero.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence. Cropped from a portrait original to a wide hero framing.
hero.verification: Downloaded the original (2912x4368) from Wikimedia Commons and viewed it directly: the file's own description reads 'Fireworks show over Cinderella Castle at closing hour. Disneyworld, Orlando 2010', and the image shows fireworks bursting directly above the castle's recognizable spires. Used as this seasonal guide's hero (its current hero is a generic Unsplash Halloween-wreath stock photo) rather than as a specific event pick, since no single photo can represent all 18 dated events on the page; the castle and fireworks are real and photographed at the real venue.
